1. Platform Architecture Overview

The Olympus SP-550UZ is powered by the TruePic III application-specific processor (Sanyo Coach platform, board code SG155, firmware build v155-77). It integrates a 32-bit ARMv5TE core with dedicated imaging DSP hardware.

Target CameraOlympus SP-550UZ (Ultra Zoom 18x)

Processor CoreARMv5TEJ (Little-Endian, pure 32-bit ARM mode)

4. Platform Subsystem References

On-Screen Display (OSD) Engine (DISP_)

The OSD engine composites live preview graphics, AF brackets, battery meters, and menus onto the hardware overlay. Master entry point is 0x401B32F4 (DISP_OsdDispatcher), which switches across 25 modes via jump table 0x401B3324.

0x401b32f4: cmp   r2, #0x18         ; OSD mode bound check (0x00 to 0x18)
0x401b32f8: ldrls pc, [pc, r2, lsl #2] ; Indirect dispatch via 0x401b3324
0x401b32fc: b     0x401b3864        ; Default target: Clean Epilogue

Modes 0x00 (Normal HUD), 0x01 (Grid/Histogram), 0x02/0x03/0x08 (Minimal HUD / Clean view). Central AF box renderer is at 0x401ad504; preview compositor loop operates at 0x40251934 with hooks at 0x401b28b0.

Real-Time Executive (RTOS) & Event Dispatcher

The event-driven operating system dispatches system events via the event dispatcher at 0x4019E1E8, reading from event jump table 0x4019E324 (16 entries, events 0x00 through 0x0F).

EventTarget HandlerDescription
0x000x4019E5F0Standard Task Wakeup Event
0x010x4019E8F8Mode Transition Dispatch
0x020x4019E6B8Lens Motor Position & Optical Zoom Tracking
0x070x4019E9CCSecondary Idle Sleep Event Handler (calls 0x4014bb18)
0x0E0x4019E9F8LCD Backlight Dimming Event Handler (150s timeout)
0x0F0x4019E9C0Primary Idle Sleep Event Handler (calls 0x4014b264)

Power Management, Display Destination & Sleep Inhibit

Global system state resides at SDRAM blackboard 0x41f80000. Master state struct at 0x41f8ddcc stores display output destination at offset +0x5a: 0 (LCD), 1 (EVF), 4 (NTSC Video Out), 6 (PAL Video Out). Inactivity countdown timer at 0x41f8ddac ticks down to trigger sleep transitions 0x4014B264 and 0x4014BB18. Sleep is inhibited by query function 0x4012FEF4 and polled by 0x40184be0, which zeroes sleep threshold packet sp[6]=0 at 0x40184d84.

Sensor & ISP Pipeline (REC_ / SYSFNC_)

Continuous sensor streaming is orchestrated by 0x40176B38 (REC_ThroughCtrl) routing draft sensor frames to DRAM buffers. Video buffer pixel clocks for NTSC/PAL DAC output are programmed by 0x400D4AC0 (SYSFNC_FMT_set_BufA_clock). Factory CCD calibration tables for dead pixel defect correction reside at 0x402b8000.

Storage Subsystem & NAND Flash Translation (BML_ / STL_)

The storage layer pairs the Tokyo Electron Device FSB FAT filesystem with Samsung-style Block Management (BML_) and Sector Translation (STL_) layers for xD-Picture cards and internal NAND. Firmware card update path requires file /FIRMWARE/FIRMWARE.BIN (FAT 8.3 FIRMWAREBIN), validated by 0x402918D4 and executed by 0x40291694.

PTP-over-SCSI & USB Flashing Protocol

USB communication operates over USB Mass Storage bulk endpoints via tunneled SCSI Command Descriptor Blocks (CDBs): 0xC0 (PTP Command), 0xC1 (PTP Data Send), 0xC4 (PTP Data Query), and 0xDF (Vendor Mode Switch). Supported PTP opcodes include 0x1001 (GetDeviceInfo), 0x100C (SendObjectInfo, Storage ID 0x80000001), 0x9119 (SendFirmwareChunk), 0x9121 (FirmwareCheck), and 0x9123 (UpdateInitiate). Handled by dispatcher 0x40316ED8.
